# 0x22A — `brake_switch`

DLC 2 · 10 Hz · status: **confirmed**

Two bytes, normally 00 00. One bit is the brake light switch, set by either brake. Every other bit stayed 0 through a whole day of riding.

## Layout

Bytes are numbered from 0. Multi-byte values are big-endian unless a row says otherwise. Bit 7 is the most significant bit of a byte.

| Byte | Content |
|---|---|
| B0 | — |
| B1 | `brake_switch` |

## Signals

| Signal | Where | Type | Value | Unit | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `brake_switch` | B1 bit 3 | flag | raw |  | confirmed (medium) |
| `b1_motion_flag` | B1 bits 7..4 | 4-bit field | raw |  | ruled out |

### `brake_switch`

Brake light switch: set by the rear pedal switch or the front lever switch, the same signal as 0x268 B4 bit 2.

**Confirmed by:** The rider's announced lever squeezes and pedal presses at standstill.

**How we know:** A standstill test, front lever four times, then rear pedal four times: set during all eight. Equal to 0x268 B4 bit 2 in 99.76 % of 100 Hz samples over a day of riding; 2209 of 2217 frames with that bit on in an earlier ride, 99.2 % on another.

### `b1_motion_flag`

An early reading of B1 = 0x50 as "moving" did not hold: B1 stays 0x00 at a sustained 100 km/h.
